architecture_notes.small_mario: All 8 OAM sprites (slots 1-8) are sprite-rendered. Full 2×4 = 16×32px body.
architecture_notes.big_mario: 4 OAM sprites for lower body (slots 5-8). Head rendered via BG nametable tiles (top 4 slots use blank tile 0xFC to let BG show through).
architecture_notes.fire_mario: Identical tiles to Big Mario. Differs only in PPU sprite palette: white (#30) + dark red (#16) + orange (#27) instead of Big Mario's red/tan palette.
architecture_notes.enemy_source: OAM data from oracle-captured entity manifest (jsnes runtime oracle sweep).
architecture_notes.chr_sections: PT0/PT1 sections show all non-blank CHR-ROM tiles with 4 palette variants per cell (quadrant layout).
